Orthogonality supplies the full beta-integral spectrum. Direct differentiation proves strict monotone likelihood ratios at every interior t. Standard exact beta and endpoint Laplace estimates yield C m^(s+2)T^m and the two-power comparator ratio. Threshold inversion with exact square-multiplicities gives the L^2 log L excess with O(L^2) remainder. The packaged standard-library checker passed 4395 finite assertions, not invoked as infinite proof.

value.rationale: The problem is the natural compact concentration operator for a fixed hyperbolic subball and its ordinary harmonic comparator, directly motivated by sharp localization and spectral approximation in H-harmonic Bergman spaces. Complete eigenvalue multiplicities and strict ordering make the count intrinsic, while the universal 2L^2 log L/c^3 excess isolates the effect of hyperbolic harmonicity beyond a routine radial diagonalization. The exact logarithmic correction and two-power enhancement provide a quantitative comparison not given by known global Schatten class criteria.
